title: Webhook delivery status values disagree with database constraint
notes: Cluster G from the final integration run: webhook transaction rollback, orphan pickup, and pause-subscription target tests insert pending, failed, or BOGUS values that violate webhook_deliveries_status_check. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6576-6730.
root_cause: Category D (test error). Migration 085 and ISS-0205 (GH #400) corrected dispatcher.zig to write uppercase status values (PENDING, DELIVERED, FAILED) matching the CHECK constraint. The test file tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig was not updated — three expectEqualStrings assertions still reference legacy lowercase/obsolete values: line 589 expects 'failed' (should be 'FAILED'), line 654 expects 'exhausted' (should be 'FAILED'; 'exhausted' was remapped by migration 085 step 3 and is outside the constraint domain), line 754 expects 'success' (should be 'DELIVERED'; 'success' likewise remapped and outside domain).
candidate_resolution: Update three expectEqualStrings calls in tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig: line 589 'failed'->'FAILED', line 654 'exhausted'->'FAILED', line 754 'success'->'DELIVERED'. No production code changes required.
